title: Gummy and fractal chess: approved playable milestone
status: Local chess and the checkmate overlay are user-tested. Embedded Arcade Chess, aligned glass insets and three saved capture mechanics are implemented. Native desktop GPU checks cover glass views and all three motions; physical iOS/tablet timing and angular-contact acceptance remain open. Authored collections and private friend sessions remain planned.
objective: Turn the published gummy chess showcase into a playable local chess experience, retaining the creator and cinema paths.
horizon: Validate board and capture changes on physical tablets; next introduce one authored fractal pawn and saved collections, then private friend sessions.
master_plan_reconciliation: The 2026-09-30 concept status and initial gap list are historical. Six gummy roles, full board, capture rendering, repeatable cinema delivery, local legal chess and PGN/Cinema handoff now exist. Editable IFS role collections remain unfinished.

Per-piece palettes, glass and lava board looks

effort_rubric.S: Contained established path plus focused verification
effort_rubric.M: Several connected components or one known integration
effort_rubric.L: Multiple subsystems and substantial state/validation work
effort_rubric.XL: Research, uncertain architecture or several milestones

estimate_scope: Relative judgments, not calendar promises. Includes integration and verification; target-device profiling is not yet measured.

matrix_grouping.impact: High goes to higher impact; Medium and Low go to lower immediate impact for the playable-local-chess objective. P0 is a prerequisite outside the feature quadrants.
matrix_grouping.effort: S and M go to lower relative effort; L and XL to higher. Boundary estimates keep their range visible and use the higher band conservatively.

parallel_discovery: G3 physical tablet measurement can proceed alongside the G8 authored-pawn work when the target device is available. Profile the new angular contact before expanding mechanics; do not infer device performance from desktop Tablet quality.
first_milestone: G15-G17 implementation delivered for review. Next acceptance: target-device capture timing and angular contact. Next feature: one authored fractal pawn through edit, save, reopen, board placement and Cinema.

alternate_objective.note: The existing image quality and native export are already delivered; prioritization changes with the goal.

candidates.title: Shared chess rules and move receipts
candidates.current_state: Implemented and verified: chess.js 1.4.0 BSD-2-Clause adapter; 35 focused rules/FEN/receipt/PGN tests pass.
candidates.outcome: Provide one authoritative chess state reusable by the board, replay and cinema.
acceptance: Maintained rules dependency reviewed and exact chess.js 1.4.0 installed in core.
Retain complete FEN state, stable piece IDs and before/after move receipts.
Verify normal moves, king safety, castling, en passant, promotion and terminal states.
candidates.uncertainty: The separate Cinema validator is preserved. Current-position draw claims are implemented; declared-next-move claims and exhaustive geometric dead-position proofs are outside this slice.

candidates.title: Playable local gummy chess
candidates.current_state: Implemented and verified at /gummy?view=match: local play, legal destinations, special moves, presets, skip/replay/undo and validated session recovery. Native hardware browser flow passes; physical tablet testing remains separate.
candidates.outcome: Play a short local game, capture a piece, skip or replay the effect, and continue.
acceptance: Legal selection and alternating turns work from a starting position or loaded FEN.
Rules commit each move once, independently of animation or GPU failure.
Full playback and Skip reach the identical post-move position; Undo restores the prior position.
Special moves have explicit presentation semantics and kings are never captured.
The next player can move after the effect; a move receipt can open in Cinema.
candidates.uncertainty: Physical iOS/tablet frame cost remains unmeasured. The user completed a game through checkmate; automated GPU verification is on desktop hardware. Only ordinary captures use the crush presentation; special moves have lightweight animations.

candidates.title: Physical tablet performance pass
candidates.outcome: Keep interaction responsive with a measured cost budget.
acceptance: Measure solver, surface generation, lighting and recording separately on the actual target tablet.
Keep a replayable before/after capture with visual quality checks.
Change the demonstrated bottleneck and expose a low-cost live setting.
candidates.uncertainty: A bounded measurement-only first slice is S. Hardware access is required; no speedup is promised before profiling.

candidates.title: Named shot library
candidates.outcome: Save, name, duplicate and reopen a Cinema recipe without juggling JSON files.
acceptance: A saved shot restores position, move, material, colours, board and camera after reload.
Malformed imports and name conflicts preserve existing saved data.
candidates.uncertainty: This first slice excludes a batch queue and continuous multi-move simulation.

candidates.title: PGN to replay and Cinema
candidates.current_state: Implemented and verified: bounded mainline PGN import/export, history stepping, full setup FEN and reloadable ordinary capture handoff to Cinema.
candidates.outcome: Turn a real game into selectable capture shots.
acceptance: Import a mainline game and step its positions correctly.
Select a capture and create a valid Cinema recipe.
State support for variations and special moves explicitly.
candidates.uncertainty: Comments and side variations are omitted. En-passant and promotion captures remain legal in the match but have no Cinema handoff. External PGN resignation/agreed-draw results remain metadata, while game status and export result are rule-derived.

candidates.title: Sound in studio and native export
candidates.current_state: Approved stems and external mixer exist; browser exports are silent
candidates.outcome: Hear selected candy sounds in preview and include them in the downloaded movie.
acceptance: Preview uses timeline cues with volume and mute controls.
Export muxes audio against fixed frame timestamps.
Unsupported browser codecs produce an explicit supported fallback.
candidates.uncertainty: Audio timing, seeking and codec capabilities need verification. More paid sound generation is unnecessary for this slice.

candidates.title: Thinner necks and smoother small debris
candidates.current_state: MPM and marching cubes work; detached masses still look bead-like
candidates.outcome: Improve the material response during separation while keeping a fixed performance budget.
acceptance: Compare matched pulls with controlled particle resolution, surface kernel and material settings.
Separate surface smoothing effects from physical separation changes.
Check volume loss, stability and frame cost alongside appearance.
candidates.uncertainty: Start with a bounded experiment; marching cubes alone cannot change the physical tearing law.

candidates.title: Arcade Chess entry and visual setup sidebar
candidates.current_state: Implemented and Chromium-verified: ArcadeHub lazily mounts ChessWorld at #arcade=chess, with an explicit return callback, scrolling glass sidebar, Marble/Lagoon/Candy palette cards and Classic/Glass/Lava board cards. Three exit/re-entry cycles retained the move and saved looks; Firefox production layouts pass at desktop and phone sizes; physical devices remain untested.
candidates.outcome: Enter Chess without an agent connection and choose its look using a full board view with large piece-set and board cards.
acceptance: Arcade opens Chess directly and provides a clear return path while preserving the editor document and current match.
Sidebar follows the deep-zoom glass-panel treatment, with independent scrolling and reachable desktop/tablet/phone controls.
Large app-rendered piece-set and board cards show explicit selected states and apply the chosen look; distinguish palette looks from new geometry.
Card previews do not mount hidden simulations; navigation keeps active GPU work and resource ownership bounded.
candidates.uncertainty: All three palette looks share the current six gummy moulds. Editor shortcuts and GPU/animation loops are gated while explicit exports continue. Native Chromium observed stable resources and zero idle GPU submissions; this is not a total-VRAM or physical-tablet performance measurement. Friend sessions and authored fractal shapes remain followups.

candidates.title: Aligned inset glass chess board
candidates.current_state: Implemented: shared CPU/GPU contact grid, 64 flush frosted/tinted material insets and etched bevel shading at y=0, neutral glass substrate and a separate caustic receiver without a second playing grid. The floor follow-up removes the unfocused rectangular light footprint and etched-grid transmission; native overhead, grazing and near-horizontal views pass. 67 focused tests pass; native Chromium top/grazing captures show alignment with no shader errors. Live final integration and physical-device checks remain separate.
candidates.outcome: Render one glass chess board whose clear and tinted or frosted insets align with picking, piece placement and highlights.
acceptance: Define square size, origin, parity, bounds and contact height once for rendering and picking.
All 64 playable insets share the top contact plane; lower floor is a caustic receiver without a second playing grid.
Top and grazing views, corner selections, orbit/zoom and capture framing show aligned squares, markers and piece bases.
Compare Classic and Lava and measure the glass pass cost to catch regressions.
candidates.uncertainty: Insets are analytic surface materials on the shared flat slab, not separate meshes or recessed collision shapes. No extra draw calls, textures or per-frame geometry; shader arithmetic increased modestly, so physical-tablet timing still needs measurement. Native Arcade markers/capture framing pass; all-corner touch selection remains open.

candidates.title: Varied capture mechanics with seeded selection
candidates.current_state: Implemented: seeded Press and settle, Shoulder sweep and Rock and shear, occupancy-bounded travel/yaw, matched collider angular contact, saved match appearance/motion and fixed Cinema choices. Native desktop AMD checks passed all three at Tablet quality on the Glass pawn-knight shot; Studio controls passed at 1440/834/390px. Physical iOS/tablet acceptance remains open.
candidates.outcome: Use press-and-settle, shoulder-sweep and rock-and-shear once per shuffled round, preserving the destination square and replayable shots. Crowded positions retain the safe press fallback.
acceptance: Implemented: versioned mechanic IDs and explicit bounded motion; conservative mould footprints and occupancy limit lateral travel and yaw.
Implemented: choose once from a receipt seed with no immediate repeat where compatible alternatives exist; session v2 saves resolved motion and a deep appearance snapshot.

Verified by focused tests: replay, reload, Cinema handoff, Undo, branching and historical draw claims preserve the chosen effect or remove its orphaned envelope. Version 1 sessions retain legacy early-shear motion.

Implemented and tested: Studio fixed choices stage until Apply; recipe schema v3 preserves explicit motion and provenance, accepts v1/v2 legacy imports and never regenerates imported motion from metadata.

Native desktop AMD run: all three mechanics at Tablet quality retained finite sampled particle state, no marching-cubes overflow or dropped vertices, no errors/warnings and the target-square landing. Receipt: /home/maff/agent-out/chaos-master-fp/2026-10-08/glass-captures/capture-native.json.
Remaining: physical iOS/tablet angular-contact and performance checks, plus matched early-smear/tear and resource comparisons across more roles, presets and crowded boards.
candidates.uncertainty: A seed reproduces choreography, not bit-identical particle states across GPUs. Crowded positions deliberately reduce motion. Desktop Tablet quality is not physical-device proof, and the tested pawn-knight shot does not establish visual separation or cost for every role/material pairing. Next feature milestone after device acceptance is G8's one authored pawn; friend networking remains G18 planning.

candidates.title: Private share-link friend sessions
candidates.current_state: Requested as a later phase. Current Worker has no chess room or WebSocket authority; architecture planned only.
candidates.outcome: After choosing pieces and a board, create an invitation and play a private two-seat match with another person.
acceptance: A server-owned room validates seat ownership and legal moves through the shared pure chess rules; hosting and deployment scope are reviewed separately.
Unique command IDs and expected revisions make duplicate/stale submissions safe; accepted receipts form an ordered move log.
Expiring invitations are separate from per-seat resume credentials; room IDs alone cannot authorize moves.
Pin board/collection manifests and capture mechanic/version/seed; physics, camera and recording remain local with independent quality tiers.
Reconnect restores a bounded snapshot and subsequent receipts without repeating a move; slow rendering cannot block authoritative state.
Two network clients pass illegal/duplicate/concurrent moves, disconnect/rejoin, reload, expired invitation, seat impersonation and final-result agreement.
First release is private and untimed, with explicit resign/draw/reconnect behavior and room lifetime/resource budgets.
candidates.uncertainty: Proposed Cloudflare room authority needs later platform/cost validation. Accounts, ranking, clocks, spectators and matchmaking are beyond this first scope.
